# lab image-mode

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
on: card 2's chat models off (coder-2 requests go to coder), ComfyUI started.
off: ComfyUI stopped (frees all its memory), card 2 back to llama-swap.
status (default): what is on card 2. Card 1 and the speech helpers keep running.
A llama-swap config reload switches the profile off: run `lab image-mode on` again then.
Good result: on -> "ComfyUI ready"; off -> "profile off"; status shows profile, ComfyUI, card 2 memory.
```

Usage:

```
lab image-mode on|off|status [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --dry-run   show, change nothing (on/off)
```
